PARCEL Fund — fractional real-estate token marketplace
Dark / neon-arcade direction: near-black #0A0A0C, magenta #FF3D8A primary, mint #3BE37E for yield + rent, violet and amber as secondary pops. Space Grotesk display, IBM Plex Mono for every number.

Everything is clickable: filter tabs, quick-buy presets, the token slider, tab switching, watchlists, claim rent. The accent color is a tweak chip above each artboard.

All prices, yields, addresses and sponsor names are sample data for feeling out the flow — swap them before this goes anywhere real. The Reg D / 12-month lockup line on the buy panel is a placeholder too: your counsel decides the actual offering language.
